scenes.caption: 生成イメージ：本の候補を持ち寄る架空の場面。自分の画面や似た意見だけに頼らず、別の資料や人の見方を比べる様子を考えましょう。
scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: contextual scene image in a lesson about filter bubbles, echo chambers and comparing perspectives.
Primary request: three ordinary Japanese high-school students at a library table comparing different book choices: one has a tablet showing a repeated generic book-cover style, another has a different physical book, and another has a printed reference list.
Scene/backdrop: ordinary library, several plain-color book covers, no readable titles or copyrighted cover designs.
Subject: students listening to each other and pointing to different candidates, calm discussion and curiosity; no one is presented as the sole correct person.
Composition/framing: one coherent medium-wide scene, the different information sources should be distinct through objects and actions rather than text, arrows or thought bubbles.
Constraints: no actual recommendation interface, claim of guaranteed algorithmic effect, social media brands, polarized political stereotypes, readable text or identifiable real students.
Style/medium: a carefully observed editorial illustration for a Japanese high-school lesson, softly painted realistic forms, warm natural light, clear everyday objects and human actions. A single coherent scene, horizontal 3:2 composition. No montage, collage, contact sheet, infographic, arrows, labels, readable text, logos, watermarks, or recognizable real people. Keep hands and tools plausible. This is a fictional teaching image, not documentary evidence.
